items.title: 52193_Jay McShann oral history interview
items.q: So I run into Earl Hines.

ctx.x: Just one second, Jay. He must have left in '43 because he was with Earl in '43. That's what they all were saying, because of the record ban, they didn't make any records. He was with Earl.

Well, here's what. He left me in '43 and joined Earl. See, I let him go in the Paradise Theater in Detroit and then here's what happened. Andy Kirk was playing in town and Andy took him all the way back to New York. We was in New York two weeks. He got to New York a week before we did, Bird with Andy. So I run into Earl Hines. Earl Hines told me, he says, 'Now, I'll tell you something. Now, I talked to Charlie and Charlie's coming on with the group. Now, I'm going to tell you something. I'll make a man out of…
a man out of him." I says, "Okay."
